stylua.releaseVersion.markdownDescription: The release version to install, e.g. `latest`, `v2.5.2` or `v2.5`.

stylua.styluaPath.description: Specifies the path of the StyLua executable, or a command name available on PATH. If not specified, will automatically download one from the GitHub releases.

stylua.configPath.description: Specify path to stylua.toml configuration file. Passed to the language server as --config-path.

stylua.formatOptions.markdownDescription:
Extra arguments passed to `stylua --lsp`, e.g. `["--indent-type", "Spaces", "--indent-width", "4"]`. A single space separated string is accepted too.

Use the FORMATTING OPTIONS listed by `stylua -h`: `--call-parentheses`, `--collapse-simple-statement`, `--column-width`, `--indent-type`, `--indent-width`, `--line-endings`, `--preserve-block-newline-gaps`, `--quote-style`, `--sort-requires`, `--space-after-function-names`, `--syntax`. They take precedence over `stylua.toml` and `stylua.configPath`.

stylua.checkUpdate.description: Whether to check out the latest stylua version.
